title: Calloway Limited Home Warranty Billing Note: Amount of the Emergency Dispatch Charge
content:
**Clause.** An emergency dispatch charge on a Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage is worked out for the most recent emergency dispatch recorded on the coverage, on the day it is assessed, and it is linked to that dispatch's claim item; a dispatch whose claim item the inspection confirmed as a covered defect carries no dispatch charge. The scheduled dispatch charge is the program's emergency dispatch fee. The dispatch charge is the scheduled dispatch charge, rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end.

A covered defect is confirmed when the inspection of the dispatched claim item, the latest one recorded for that item, found the defect confirmed.

## Input, judgement, output

| Inspection finding on the dispatched item | Judgement | Dispatch charge |
|---|---|---|
| Defect confirmed | Covered defect | None |
| Any other finding | Dispatch chargeable | The scheduled dispatch charge, rounded to the cent |

## Worked figures (hypothetical program emergency dispatch fee USD 125.00)

1. The latest dispatch went to an active water leak item that the inspection found to be a homeowner maintenance item: dispatch charge USD 125.00.
2. The latest dispatch went to a no heat item whose inspection confirmed the defect: no dispatch charge.
3. Two dispatches are recorded on the coverage; the charge is worked out for the later of the two and linked to its claim item.
